questions.title: Snippet Two-Pointer Reverse Trace
questions.description: What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
s = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
l, r = 0, len(s) - 1
while l < r:
    s[l], s[r] = s[r], s[l]
    l += 1
    r -= 1
print(s)

questions.title: Snippet Fixed Window Trace
questions.description: The window size is k = 3 and the sum slides across the array. What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
nums = [2, 1, 5, 1, 3, 2]
k = 3
best = sum(nums[:k])
cur = best
for i in range(k, len(nums)):
    cur += nums[i] - nums[i - k]
    best = max(best, cur)
print(best)

questions.title: Snippet Variable Window Trace
questions.description: The window shrinks from the left while its sum is at least target, tracking the shortest length. What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
nums = [2, 3, 1, 2, 4, 3]
target = 7
left = 0
cur = 0
best = len(nums) + 1
for i, n in enumerate(nums):
    cur += n
    while cur >= target:
        best = min(best, i - left + 1)
        cur -= nums[left]
        left += 1
print(best)

questions.title: Snippet Sorted Two-Sum Trace
questions.description: The array is sorted and scanned from both ends. What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
nums = [1, 2, 4, 7, 11]
target = 9
l, r = 0, len(nums) - 1
found = None
while l < r:
    s = nums[l] + nums[r]
    if s == target: found = (l, r); break
    if s < target: l += 1
    else: r -= 1
print(found)

questions.title: Snippet Popcount Loop Trace
questions.description: bits(n) repeatedly clears the lowest set bit. What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
def bits(n):
    count = 0
    while n:
        n = n & (n - 1)
        count += 1
    return count
out = [bits(x) for x in [7, 8, 15, 16]]
print(out)

questions.title: Snippet Kadane Trace
questions.description: cur is the best sum ending here; best is the overall best. What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
nums = [-2, 1, -3, 4, -1, 2, 1, -5, 4]
cur = best = nums[0]
for n in nums[1:]:
    cur = max(n, cur + n)
    best = max(best, cur)
print(cur, best)
